title: react-instantsearch-nextjs breaks on Cloudflare Pages
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

The NextJS package with routing has hanging promises which fail and break the SSR renderer in the worker on Cloudflare Pages. My guess is it's a fetch implementation that's broken in their environment. 

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Create an app router page in Nextjs 14. 
2. Install the nextjs instantsearch package and render it
3. Deploy to cloudflare pages
4. Cloudflare pages will throw an error: `[Uncaught (in response) Error: The script will never generate a response]`

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/solitary-grass-lqknn5?workspaceId=ws_CUwuwFRhcyzgdBykwr8y6o

### 💭 Expected behavior

The worker is able to return a proper error message or actually just render the page.

### Package version

react-instantsearch-nextjs 0.3.20

### Operating system

_No response_

_No response_

comments.body:
Did you use the fetch requester ? Doesn't show that on the Codesandbox you linked : 
https://www.algolia.com/doc/libraries/javascript/v4/customize/#changing-http-request-methods

By default it still uses XHR, which doesn't work on cloudflare pages I think ?
You're right! I see now. Thanks heaps for pointing me in the right direction.
v5 of algoliasearch has an entry point for workers that enables this out of the box by the way
